title: Among public high schools (SOC = 66) in Los Angeles County that opened afte
question: Among public high schools (SOC = 66) in Los Angeles County that opened after 2005 and are not charter schools, find the one with the lowest SAT excellence rate. Return its full physical address (Street, City, State, Zip) and the eligible free meal rate for students aged 5–17.

prediction.sql:
SELECT s."XCL_048", s."XCL_050", s."XCL_052", s."XCL_051", CAST(f."XCL_025" AS REAL) / f."XCL_024" AS free_meal_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
WHERE s."XCL_068" = '66'
  AND s."XCL_045" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s."XCL_061" > '2005-01-01'
  AND s."XCL_063" = 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat."XCL_040" AS REAL) / sat."XCL_036" ASC
LIMIT 1
